feeds.title: ITavisen
feeds.description: ITavisen serves news, tests, comments, video, games and game tests around the clock to the Norwegian people as one of the oldest online newspapers in Norway.

feeds.title: Digi.no
feeds.description: Digi.no is published by Teknisk Ukeblad Media majorly about IT industry. Read about updates in the IT industry, upcoming technologies, interviews and more!

feeds.title: Teknisk Ukeblad
feeds.description: News about technology and Norwegian technology companies. We cover energy, maritime, construction, industry, health, electric cars, aircraft and transport.

feeds.title: Norwegian SciTech News
feeds.description: Research news written for the general public about technology, energy and environment, science, fish and aquaculture, innovation, health, the social sciences and humanities. Norwegian SciTech News is published jointly by the Norwegian University of Science and Technology and SINTEF, Scandinavia's largest independent research institute.

feeds.title: Norway Health Tech
feeds.description: Norway Health Tech has a vision of making Norway the world's best arena for health innovation. We are a not-for-profit member organization with close to 270 members in our base - representing the full value chain of healthcare. We address all areas of human health - with an eye for technology. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates, insights in medical technology.

feeds.title: Kairos Technology
feeds.description: Read news articles about recent product development and other relevant information from Kairos Technology. Kairos Technology is a software company passionate about creating new insights for the design and operation of plants. Our mission is to improve production effectiveness by providing software that will reduce effects of abnormal situations, avoid shutdowns, and provide real-time decision support when abnormalities occur in complex industrial systems.

feeds.title: Instech Blog
feeds.description: For nearly 30 years, Instech has been at the forefront of marine insurance technology development. Instech's mission is to improve the working lives of marine insurance professionals around the world. Our sustainable technology, designed to evolve, brings people together. The blog features all the latest news from the company, insights, trends in software industry and more!

feeds.title: Blog.bardalen.no
feeds.description: This is a blog about modern IT, retro tech and everything in between. The topics will be taken from my everyday life as a consultant for companies in the SME market. The blog will contain solutions to problems I stumble upon in my everyday work, considerations and views on topics that fit in. Check here for tips and tricks on PowerShell, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, IT security, networking and cloud solutions. Will also from time to time visit my childhood reminiscing about old PCs with 2/3/486 processors and far too little memory to run the games you wanted!

feeds.title: abcb Blog
feeds.description: abcb helps tech companies scale and enter new markets. We are operational experts in international software and tech business, and help clients change and expand their businesses. Our experienced executives deliver consultancy services and interim leaders to our clients. Since we started abcb in 2018, we have worked with more than twenty companies from five different countries. Explore our blog for insights and tips in technology and business, the latest trends and more.

feeds.title: Field Geo
feeds.description: Field is a sustainability-focused technology company, leveraging geodata competence, proprietary software and geospatial technologies to provide customers with the data and insights needed to build and maintain a better tomorrow. Discover our insights in different areas like nature, urban, sustainability and more with regards to technology.

feeds.title: NTNU TekNat Blog
feeds.description: NTNU TekNat is a blog about technology, research and education at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU). Our blog entries are written by our employees and students.
